scope.later_commit_note: Focused diff confirms no changes between base and c68a19df2 in native_model_owner, native_node_destruction or native_resource_support header/source pairs. This audit remains pinned to base; parent separately integrated the gather overload.

conclusions: All three actual renderer fields +19E0/+19E4/+19E8 receive the B4C700 generated-model result; +19E0 was newly resolved by exact existing instructions despite no containing Ghidra function.

Current main already has complete model construction B75030, destruction B750C0 and scalar deletion B75290, including an additive actual-header/raw-name construction path. No duplicate model reconstruction or shared-file replacement is needed.

The older factory/destructor are mutually consistent in the nonnull NativeStringStorage adapter domain, which current main still supports. They reject the newer raw model domain because the old factory requires actual_names == &strings and the old destructor requires actual_names != nullptr.

A minimal compatible extension consists of an explicit expected name-service binding in the future renderer destructor context and a separate raw generated-model overload borrowing current raw pool cells and node constants. Keep existing adapter entrypoints and every owner/runtime/cell guard.

Native producer type evidence does not supply canonical host bindings or an application renderer producer. Complete derived renderer construction/destruction, control-worker binding and EndFrame admission remain separately gated.

concrete_patch_proposal.why_both_sides: Changing only the destructor can admit externally prepared raw models but does not make the old B4C700 source produce them. Changing only the factory would generate models rejected by the older consumer. Native byte evidence supports the same model lifetime for all three fields; host mode/context agreement is the missing source composition.

genuine_storage_fixture_prerequisites: Use one actual NativeModelPoolStorage/NativeModelPool over genuine 0x188 slots, actual slab bookkeeping and critical section; preserve the +0x184 slot index and return exactly once through B74750. Destroy the pool only after all owners/references are gone.

Borrow one actual AA0 manager publication, AA8 NativeStringPoolStorage publication and AA4 small-return flag. Use the existing substantive raw singleton/name pool providers; an already-published actual pool tests the fast path only, not cold manager construction.

Supply actual nonempty 8-byte model-name storage and accessible live data; real CE4970/CE4ADC/D7A24C/D7A208/D7A260 cells; valid current D62DE8/D62C88 profile views with required extents and selectors. Do not call numeric EXE addresses as host function pointers.

Use the same SceneAttachmentRuntime, GeneratedModelLifetimeRuntime/actual_nodes.attachments, NativeRenderActualOwners and ModelTypeBootstrap throughout. prepare_model and bind_completed_model must create/register the exact NativeModelOwner and NativeModelReference for that slot; callbacks are host identity bookkeeping, not native constructor substitutes.

Retire the canonical reference/companion after physical pool return without reading freed native fields. The host reference remains alive until its explicit disposal callback; no implicit live NativeModelOwner destruction.

For the smallest consumer trajectory, construct one genuine raw model with real name allocation and valid null retained174/geometry180, then invoke existing B6DFA0 source through its canonical reference. Verify logical release, count-zero scalar path, one pool return and same actual name-ring recycling. This is a model consumer fixture, not full B4C700 or full B32920 validation.

A nonnull retained174 or geometry180 requires a genuine supported canonical terminal and real retained count/scene relationships. Full B4C700 requires the actual mesh/declaration/stream/material/effect/section provider closure; nulling these fields afterward does not validate that factory.

A renderer-member fixture must place the same canonical model raw address in its real +19E0/E4/E8 cell only after completed construction/binding. Verify the cell clears only after B6DFA0 returns; do not fabricate a success/no-op lifetime callback to exercise the schedule.

Keep cleanup-failure probes separate from the canonical final-release trajectory: B6DFA0 source, NativeModelReference::release_model_virtual18 and release_zero_references are noexcept. A raw name-pool getter throw can propagate from explicit direct model deletion, but cannot be claimed to propagate through this canonical noexcept terminal graph.

Reuse the existing raw model source probe as a starting point if a later implementation requires validation; one focused additional genuine-storage canonical-unlink trajectory suffices for this contract risk. No new test or executable was created or run in this audit.
